visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman sit together on a gray sofa in an indoor living room. The woman wears a gray crop top and dark camo shorts, holding a black spider-shaped head massager. The man is dressed in a gray athletic t-shirt. Behind them are white shelves stocked with anime figurines and plush toys. (2) The camera zooms in on the woman holding the device, which features several curved legs with black nodes at the tips. She gestures towards the device while speaking enthusiastically. (3) The scene cuts to the device sitting on a wooden table, vibrating and moving slightly. The man and woman point at it, their expressions a mix of curiosity and amusement. (4) The man places the black massager onto the woman's head. She closes her eyes and makes a skeptical face. (5) In a close-up, the woman's hand is shown pressing a power button on top of the device. A small blue indicator light flashes. (6) The woman then places the massager on the man's head, which fits tightly around his skull. They both laugh as he reacts to the sensation. (7) Both sit on the couch, continuing their discussion. The woman gestures broadly with her hands, while the man wears the device, looking directly at the camera. (8) The video concludes with the couple laughing and talking, with the woman briefly wearing the massager again before looking at the camera for a final address.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 女友的廢物時間. [Logo]: zoebitalk. (2) [Subtitle]: 又來了一個小神器! 大家不要色色. (3) [Subtitle]: 這不是什麼吧... 幫我接話不會嗎? (4) [Subtitle]: 這看起來滿值得色色的吧? (5) [Subtitle]: 我看起來很像惡魔果實. (6) [Subtitle]: 我睡覺的時候很喜歡阿翔幫我摸頭. (7) [Subtitle]: 可是很常阿翔可能就睡著了. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以我就買這個東西. 想說要自己幫自己摸頭. (9) [Subtitle]: 我先幫你戴. 你覺得你的大腦要被吸走. (10) [Subtitle]: 我覺得好像要被控制大腦的感覺. (11) [Subtitle]: 那你要怎麼辦? 你要變異形? (感受中). (12) [Subtitle]: 感覺好像有個生物. 他把他的心臟放在我的腦袋. (13) [Subtitle]: 然後在跳動... 這感覺有點奇怪. (14) [Subtitle]: 你的腦袋被寄生了. (15) [Subtitle]: 他完全沒有在抓頭的爽感. 他也可以調強度. (16) [Subtitle]: 那你幫我調最強! 直接在頭上狂打的感覺. 就醬子?? 就這. (17) [Subtitle]: (換人). 你幫我放下去的那一刻好舒服... (18) [Subtitle]: 你應該去找一個他會這樣子的. (上上下下). (19) [Subtitle]: 對! 但是他會交叉震動. (20) [Subtitle]: 這個東西能輔助我睡著嗎? (測試中...). (21) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這東西如果你帶著他睡覺. 不但沒有幫你助眠的效果. (22) [Subtitle]: 他還會提醒你. 就好像有人這樣子推一下你的頭. 起床喔! (23) [Subtitle]: 所以這個東西又失敗了? 太爛了! (24) [Subtitle]: 蛤?! 光看他構造就覺得這一定是個失敗的作品. (25) [Subtitle]: 你禮貌嗎? 我上次幫你買那個鼻毛的... (26) [Subtitle]: (小倆口持續試用中...). 真的耶. 我開發出他的新功能. (27) [Subtitle]: 但他真的沒有辦法按到穴道. 爛! 結論! 不要買!!! (28) [Subtitle]: 好那我們為了不浪費. 那這支影片想要體驗的朋友留言! 我寄去給你! (29) [Subtitle]: 留言陷害你朋友. \XDDD\. (30) [Subtitle]: 留言說你覺得阿翔哪個優點你最喜歡? 蛤? 跟我有什麼關係? (31) [Subtitle]: #留言抽獎. 募集阿翔誇誇金句! (32) [Subtitle]: 好這樣就好. 這東西真的沒用.
